selector.rationale: Erythema Induratum best explains the clinical presentation of painful lesions, bilateral lower extremity swelling, and multiple discrete, round, dry ulcers with central eschars and dusky gray borders, supported by histopathological findings of mid- and deep dermal marked lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils and focal abscess.
